note: NECO Physics round 5 (R32 top-up): micrometer 0.01 mm; mass constant everywhere; impulse as force times time; conservation of energy; staircase power 250 W; the wheelbarrow as a second-class lever; Boyle's law; barometer lower on the mountain; relative density; floating ice; latent heat of fusion; evaporation versus boiling; metal pot, plastic handle; Brownian motion; timbre; ultrasound; amplitude; the tightened guitar string; thunder after lightning; magnification ratio; virtual image; convex driving mirror; glass rod losing electrons; voltmeter in parallel; wire length doubles resistance; the iron's heating effect; trivalent p-type; the transistor amplifying; beta as electron; gamma leaving A and Z untouched; the Geiger counter; 800 g halved thrice to 100 g; film badges and tongs; induction by a moving magnet; Hooke's law; the door's far edge. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC Physics (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
